text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Today in the Elven Forest, Kyoka is helping
{0} and Mimi with their studies.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}とミミは、
エルフの森でキョウカに勉強を教えてもらっていた。

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: Kyoka... How do I do this part?
text_block_list.orig_text:
キョウカちゃーん、
ここ
どうやるの～？

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Oh, for this question, you can calculate it like this... You see?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ここはね、
こうやって計算すれば……
ほら！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh! You're right!
Eheheh... You're a good teacher, Kyoka.
You make everything so easy to understand!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ～！
　ほんとだ～！
　
えへへ～、
キョウカちゃんの教え方、
やさしくってわかりやすいね～♪

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
R-really? I'm glad you think that...
By the way, are you feeling better today?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほ、
本当？
　
それならよかった……
そういえば、
もう熱は大丈夫なの？

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh!
When I drank that medicine you bought me, I felt better right away!
You went on a big adventure, right? Mr. Nice Guy told me all about it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うんっ！
　みんながくれたお薬のんだらね、
すぐ元気になっちゃった♪
すっごい探検だったんでしょ？
　おにいちゃんから聞いたんだ～

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
That's right! There was a labyrinth full of traps,
and a monster thiiiis big in the shape of a lamp!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん！
　罠がたくさんある迷宮とか、
ランプの形した
おっっきい魔物とか！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Woooow!
I would've been so scared, I might have given up and run away...
text_block_list.orig_text:
すご～いっ！
ミミならこわくて、
途中であきらめちゃうかも……

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
I was scared too, but Misogi and {0} were there...
And when I thought about making the medicine for you, suddenly I didn't feel scared at all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私も怖かったけど、
ミソギと{0}さんがいて……
ミミに元気になってほしいって思って、
そしたら全然怖くなくなったよ！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: So next time, you should come exploring with us too! Promise!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だからね、
今度はみんなで探検に行こうっ、
絶対！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: Sure! Exploring~♪ Exploring~♪ It sounds so much fun~! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
うんっ！
　たんけん♪
　たんけん♪
　たのしみだな～♪

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Kyoka! Kyoka!
text_block_list.orig_text:
キョウカ～！
　キョウカ～！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: Ahh! Misogi's here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ～！
　ミソギちゃんだ～！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Why's she all worked up this time?
Don't tell me she messed up on another test...
text_block_list.orig_text:
またあんなに慌てて……
もしかして
また悪い点とったんじゃ――！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Great Teacher Kyoka! I totally did it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
キョウカだいせんせー！
　ミソギやったよー！！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Wahh! What's going on, Misogi? Wait, is that... a perfect score?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わっ！
　ミソギどうしたの……
ってこれ！
　満点のテスト！？

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
It's all because you taught me all that stuff after our adventure!
I wasn't hopeless after all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの後、
もう一度勉強教えてくれたキョウカのおかげだよ！
ミソギはバカじゃなかったんだー！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
I knew you could do it if you tried!
Still, ahh, I suppose my teaching ability was also an important—
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミソギはやればできるんだよ！
まぁ、
けど、
私の教え方が上手だったっていうのも……

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! You're getting carried away again!
But I guess you're right! Thanks a bunch, Kyoka!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー、
また調子乗ってるー！
でも事実だからね！
　キョウカありがとう！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
I was joking! You earned these results by working so hard!
All I did was give you a little push in the right direction!
text_block_list.orig_text:
冗談だよ！
　やっぱりこれは
ミソギが頑張った結果！
私は
そのお手伝いを少ししただけだもん！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Kyokaaaa! Ahhh... You're the best!
text_block_list.orig_text:
キョウカー！
　
ううー、
大好きだよー！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Eheheh...
Oh, I bet your mom was pretty pleased
when she saw those results, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ……
あ、
これならお母さんも
大喜びだったんじゃない？

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
You bet she was! Guess what—when I showed her,
she actually said she'd increase my allowance!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そーなんだよー！
　お母さんに見したらさ、
なんと
おこづかいを増やしてくれたんだよねっ！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
So that's why I brought...
Here! A present for you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だーかーら、
お礼に……
はい、
プレゼント！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: What?! O-oh, I couldn't...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ！？
　そ、
そんな悪いよ！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: No, I insist! I bought it specially for you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいの～！
　キョウカのために買ったんだから！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: What could it be? Oh! Could she have brought one of those premium cupcakes from Landosol?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだろ……
はっ！
　もしかして
ランドソルの高級カップケーキ！？

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Well then, I suppose I can't say no... Thank you, Misogi—
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
いただいちゃおうかな。
ありがとう、
ミソギ――

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! You fell for it!
This is my latest prank: the Exploding Jack-in-the-Box!
I bought it just to see your reaction!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはははっ！
　ひっかかったー！
ミソギの新イタズラグッズ！
　粉塵ビックリ箱～！
キョウカの驚く顔が見たくて買っちゃった～♪

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: M... M... Mi...so..giiiiii!!!

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Ahahahah! Kyoka got mad again!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはははー！
　キョウカがおこったー！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Of course I'm angry! This time you've gone one step too far!
text_block_list.orig_text:
当たり前でしょ！
　今日という今日は
許さないんだから！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
You can stay out of this, {0}!
This time, Misogi's entirely in the wrong! I have to teach her a lesson!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}さんはだまっててください！
今回は完全にミソギが悪いです！
　こらしめてやります！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Sorry 'bout that, Kyoka! Ahahahahah!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わー！
　キョウカごめんなさーい！
　あはははは～！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Misogi! Hold it right there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミソギ～！
　待ちなさーい！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Like I'd make it that easy! Catch me if you can!
text_block_list.orig_text:
待つわけないじゃーん！
　つかまえてみろ～！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: Kyoka and Misogi really are the best of friends, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
キョウカちゃんとミソギちゃん、
やっぱりなかよしさんだね～♪

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
I know! Since Kyoka seems busy,
I'll help you study instead today, mister!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ
キョウカちゃんの代わりに、
ミミがおにいちゃんに
おべんきょうを教えてあげる～♪

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.orig_text:
結局いつものようにケンカをするキョウカとミソギ。
そんな二人を尻目に、
{0}に勉強を教えるミミであった。
